subject: Render ready for review: stage-aware generic resources, real magma host test, explicit gaps
body:
Implementation and host tests are ready for review. No commit, no phone/adb/build lease, no other owner files edited. Only changed production files: gpu/metal/tegu/render_encoder.inc, render_pipeline.inc, device_limits.h.

WHAT IS IMPLEMENTED
- Generic TGJ1 planning offers both stages: VS textures/samplers 0..30/0..15 and FS textures/samplers, with real stage/kind/format/dimensions/levels/samples/usage facts. Resource array 156 < Rust 186.
- Binding resolution is stage-aware for combined/combined-immutable/texture/sampler. A VS tex0 and FS tex0 are distinct native bindings and distinct retained objects. Retention is keyed by native binding (<=15) as ACKed; slot30 MRT convention and compositor/R85 paths unchanged.
- Neutral-image substitution is refused when an unsupported bound texture could be the neutral source (3D/cube/array/MSAA/multi-mip/private/unknown format). ASTC 2D is included with real facts; baseline planner refuses explicitly.
- Compiler->planner binding agreement remains a hard check. Planner-only extra descriptors are logged as TEGU_GENERIC_UNREFLECTED and skipped (compiler reflection proves non-consumption); neutral buffers/images are forwarded for valid zero/neutral descriptors; constant blobs remain pipeline data.
- VertexIndex detection from SPIR-V BuiltIn VertexIndex. Nonzero vertexStart or CPU index expansion is a command error under the current TGJ1 request (no successful missing draw); attribute-only rebasing and native indexed vertex-pulling remain. Condition matches lowering ACK.
- Non-default function constants work at library specialization: red=0/red=1 produce different fragment SPIR-V, both create and plan.
- device_limits publishes maxVertexTextures/Samplers=8, inline data=4096; fragment asserted values unchanged.

HOST EVIDENCE (no GPU claim)
1. python3 build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/render/host_test_vs_texture.py -> PASS. Real frontend + baseline AIR bridge + real n2mb + fake JM:
   - authored same-Metal-slot0 VS+FS textures/samplers: 2 distinct native bindings, correct binding-keyed retention, commit after encoder/app refs dropped;
   - start=3 VertexIndex command error, no draw job;
   - 3D and 2-level VS textures command errors via neutral check, no draw job;
   - ASTC explicit planner refusal, no neutral job;
   - native indexed pulling indices 7,2,9 keeps original uint16 BO/offset/6 bytes, no expansion;
   - attribute-only start=3 submits vertex.offset=96/bytes=96;
   - real installed graphics-01523 magma VS/FS translates, native-compiles, creates one generic job with VS texture2 + FS textures0/1/2, simulated commit succeeds.
2. python3 tests/frontend_jm_test.py -> PASS (existing format/geometry sequences).
3. ARM64 production frontend clang -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only -> no diagnostics.
4. Real corpus probes: magma plan rc0/native compile rc0 (7 bindings); Icon plan rc0/native compile rc0 (6); 49 VS-texture jobs = 22 fetch OK/17 plan OK, 12 fetch-format refusals, 15 missing constants, 5 translator-variant refusals; binding counts 4..14.
5. Limits readback 2/8/8/4096/4/1/4096, sizeof264.

REMAINING GAPS (explicit)
- 12/49 real VS-texture jobs fail native vertex-fetch formats 97/100/103/106/109 (Icon 29/25/27). Needs air_bridge.rs + vertex_fetch.c/n2r owner changes.
- Mips/array/cube/3D/MSAA: n2r v2 sidecar not frozen; render reports/refuses, no level0 substitution.
- ASTC planner class, sRGB/YCbCr variants (5/22), exact linear sampler specialization, first_vertex/base_vertex additive packet field (I posted the exact render-side contract; ready to wire when textures/compute freeze fields), multiple vertex layouts.
- Unsupported-but-unused bound texture can over-refuse when a different descriptor is legitimately neutral; compute slot-used provenance would fix.

Artifacts: workers/render/STATUS.md plus probes and host_test_vs_texture.py. Please review/commit; I will not stage other workers' files or edit NOTES.
